title: Structure modulates experience and does not generate it

statements.text: Physicalist theories face an explanatory gap because purely structural facts seem not to necessitate phenomenal facts. Here the structural facts about phase-locked field modes are tasked not with generating experience but with modulating and restricting it, a task within the reach of organization, and an underlying field of consciousness plus this mechanism is held to necessitate perspectival subjects.
